title: Technical Analysis Handbook -> V8: Strategy, Risk, Market-State and Position-Management Ideas
purpose: The book is treated as a source of falsifiable design prompts, not as evidence that any chart technique has economic value in V8.

source_pdf.file: The Handbook of Technical Analysis - The Practitioner's Comprehensive Guide to Technical Analysis 2016.pdf
source_pdf.author: Mark Andrew Lim
source_pdf.note: Page references below use the PDF page number and the printed book page number shown in the PDF.

method_note: The extraction kept only ideas that can become point-in-time features, deterministic gates, candidate metadata, simulator variants, or preregistered tests. Subjective chart reading, universal performance thresholds, and hindsight phase labels were not imported as V8 facts.

key_findings: En güçlü aktarım sinyal formülü değil, state-first ayrımıdır: trend, consolidation, volatility, participation ve location ayrı tutulmalı.

V8'in mevcut failed-breakout ve liquidity-sweep aileleri kitapta tarif edilen false-breakout, pin-bar ve re-entry mantığıyla aynı araştırma yüzeyindedir; yeni modül eklemek yerine mevcut ailelerde varyant olarak test edilmelidir.
ATR/R-normalizasyonu, stop mesafesi ve heat cap V8'in mevcut risk sözleşmesiyle uyumludur; ancak locational ATR veya dinamik pozisyon yönetimi yeni deney olmadan baseline'a alınmamalıdır.
Volume-bar-range ve volume/open-interest fikirleri ancak veri kanalının PIT ve provenance sözleşmesiyle birlikte anlamlıdır; mevcut kline + funding tape OI veya volume-at-price sağlamaz.
Confluence fikri gösterge saymak değil, farklı bilgi ailelerini audit edilebilir biçimde ayırmak olarak çevrilmelidir; fiyat tabanlı korelasyonları bağımsız kanıt saymak multicollinearity riskidir.
Kitabın risk-of-ruin, profit-factor, trade-count ve dynamic-sizing anlatıları V8 için doğrudan eşik değildir; bunlar ancak hipotez veya teşhis olarak kalabilir.
do_not_import: Fibonacci, Elliott, Gann, candlestick veya görsel chart-pattern iddialarını subjektif tanımlarla production Expert olarak eklemek.
Kitaptaki profit factor 1.5-2 veya 30 / 300-500 trade gibi genel eşikleri V8'in frozen-OOS kanıt kapısı yerine koymak.
Dynamic sizing, pyramiding, martingale-benzeri risk artırımı veya equity-curve müdahalesini varsayılan risk politikası yapmak.
Market Profile, OI, COT, sentiment veya volume-at-price bilgisini mevcut tape'te yokmuş gibi var kabul etmek.
Accumulation/distribution gibi ancak sonuçtan sonra kesinleşen sınıfları karar zamanında gözlenebilir state etiketi olarak kullanmak.

ideas.title: Market phase as a deterministic state group
ideas.one_line_v8_action: trend/consolidation state'ini feature group olarak materialize et; phase yönünü hindsight ile etiketleme.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap trend ve consolidation'ı temel fazlar olarak ayırır; moving-average ayrışması, volume davranışı ve momentum divergence'ını faz geçişi için yardımcı gözlemler olarak sunar.

ideas.v8_translation: MarketState içine deterministic bir phase context eklenebilir: trend slope/spread, rolling range, ATR state, price persistence, consolidation duration ve volume availability. Accumulation/distribution karar anında kesin sınıf değil, yalnızca açıkça tanımlanmış proxy hipotezleri olmalıdır.
ideas.implementation_surface: marketstate.py feature graph; requires=[trend, volatility, location, participation] if the channel exists; lineage hash and calculation_time bound.
ideas.guardrail: Phase label future outcome'dan türetilmez; state only closed and available rows kullanır. Phase group Expert direction seçmez, yalnızca self-gating context sağlar.
ideas.test_or_decision: Yeni bir Expert veya phase filter, existing deterministic baseline'a karşı yeni preregistration ve frozen-OOS comparison ister.

ideas.title: Three-degree context: macro, meso and micro
ideas.one_line_v8_action: üst, mevcut ve alt trend derecelerini birbirine karıştırmadan state'te tut; global 32-bar sınırını görünür bir kontrat yap.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap aynı piyasanın farklı wave/time derecelerinde aynı anda trend ve consolidation olabileceğini; üst derecenin yön, alt derecenin giriş zamanlaması için kullanılabileceğini savunur.

ideas.v8_translation: Expert'in horizon'u ve gerekli history window'u açıkça ilan edilebilir. Higher context, entry context ve lower trigger context ayrı feature groups olarak üretilebilir; state build max(declared history_bars) ile yapılır.
ideas.implementation_surface: D-032 file-family decision gerektiren Expert contract alanı; current O-020 ile doğrudan bağlantılı.
ideas.guardrail: Higher-timeframe bar kapanmadan kullanılmaz; resampling ve availability clocks ayrı tutulur. Current fixed 32-bar history sessizce aşılmaz.
ideas.test_or_decision: O-020 çözülmeden implement edilmez; çözüm, state hash'i ve ledger determinism'i değiştireceği için yeni registry decision ister.

ideas.title: Trend-quality vector instead of a single trend label
ideas.one_line_v8_action: trend quality'yi amplitude, period, retracement, range, close-location ve oscillation özellikleriyle açıklayıcı teşhis olarak ölç.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap trend gücü ve zayıflığını cycle amplitude/period, retracement symmetry, bar range, persistence, bar stochastic, body/range, barrier proximity, consolidation size ve volume-spread ilişkisiyle okur.

ideas.v8_translation: Bu fikir tek bir 'trend_strength' skoruna sıkıştırılmamalı; versioned feature group içinde ayrı deterministic fields ve diagnostics olarak tutulmalı.
ideas.implementation_surface: marketstate.py trend/history/response groups; lab report'ta state-conditioned outcome diagnostics.
ideas.guardrail: Aynı fiyat serisinden türeyen birçok feature bağımsız kanıt değildir. Feature count evidence budget değildir ama frozen-OOS family multiplicity ve search lineage korunur.
ideas.test_or_decision: Önce descriptive diagnostics; decision-path kullanımına geçiş yalnızca tek bir preregistered challenger ile.

ideas.title: Volatility contraction to expansion as a candidate habitat
ideas.one_line_v8_action: düşük ATR/bandwidth sıkışmasını habitat, yönü ise sonradan gelen PIT breakout trigger'ını belirleyen ayrı bir Expert olarak test et.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap volatility'yi farklı ölçülerle ayırır; ATR ve band width'i stop/filter için, inside-narrow-range yapılarını ise breakout habitatı için kullanır.

ideas.v8_translation: A deterministic setup: rolling ATR percentile/bandwidth compression, minimum consolidation width/duration, then a closed-bar range violation. Direction is fixed by the trigger, not selected by outcome.
ideas.implementation_surface: New Expert family under EXPERTS_REGISTRY.yaml; volatility and history requirements; simulator geometry must be fixed before development search.
ideas.guardrail: Compression does not imply direction. Entry bar is not inspected for exits; funding/tradability mask and cost gates still apply.
ideas.test_or_decision: New family-level preregistration vs no-trade and simpler breakout baseline; never added to v8_slice_001 after freeze.

ideas.title: Locational volatility for stop geometry
ideas.one_line_v8_action: global ATR yerine setup çevresindeki locational ATR'yi yalnızca preregistered stop-geometry challenger olarak karşılaştır.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap ATR'yi true-range volatility gauge olarak kullanır; stop için current ATR, local reaction ATR veya extreme ATR seçimlerini ayırır.

ideas.v8_translation: V8'in mevcut risk_unit = atr_ref baseline'ı korunur. Locational ATR yalnızca Candidate birth'ten önce gözlenen bars üzerinden hesaplanan alternatif geometry olarak tanımlanabilir.
ideas.implementation_surface: Expert geometry_version, simulator risk_unit, manifest/config hash.
ideas.guardrail: ATR seçimi outcome veya future excursion kullanamaz; non-positive unit fail closed; R-unit and cost semantics unchanged.
ideas.test_or_decision: O-007 fidelity and a fresh frozen-OOS comparison; no in-place geometry change.

ideas.title: Volume - bar range - close-location quadrants
ideas.one_line_v8_action: relative volume x relative range x close-location kombinasyonlarını continuation/reversal hipotezleri için ayrı ve denetlenebilir alanlar yap.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap wide/narrow range ile high/low volume kombinasyonlarını trend-promoting, trend-inhibiting veya reversal context'i olarak sınıflandırır.

ideas.v8_translation: Feature group: volume_z, range_z, close_location, volume_range_quadrant. Bu alanlar tek başına yön sinyali değil, Expert habitat/trigger context'i olabilir.
ideas.implementation_surface: MarketState participation/response groups; requires actual kline volume and explicit source semantics.
ideas.guardrail: Aggregate volume order-book pressure değildir. Bar range and volume must be available by decision time; no same-bar future read.
ideas.test_or_decision: First descriptive event/outcome table, then one frozen-OOS challenger. Separate price-only and volume-aware families for multiplicity.

ideas.title: Volume and open-interest confirmation/divergence
ideas.one_line_v8_action: OI channelı PIT olarak gelene kadar volume/OI divergence'ını V8 state'i sayma; geldiğinde price, volume ve OI'yi ayrı lineage ile karşılaştır.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap volume confirmation/divergence'ı trend gücü veya zayıflığı için, OI değişimini de futures participation context'i için kullanır.

ideas.v8_translation: Mevcut declared dataset kline + funding'tir. OI eklenirse event/available/ingested clocks, revision policy, venue provenance ve gaps ayrı bir data-plane contract'a bağlanmalı.
ideas.implementation_surface: DATASET_SPEC/FEED_INGESTION_SPEC extension; MarketState participation group; not a silent feature addition.
ideas.guardrail: OI veya COT gibi unavailable fields null, zero veya proxy volume olarak doldurulmaz.
ideas.test_or_decision: Coverage audit passes first; then preregistered comparison. Until then status DATA_BLOCKED.

ideas.title: False-breakout, pin and Hikkake re-entry family
ideas.one_line_v8_action: yeni Expert eklemek yerine mevcut failed_breakout ve liquidity_sweep ailelerinde explicit re-entry variants olarak sınırla.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap barrier ihlalinden sonra fiyatın tekrar içeri dönmesini false breakout/re-entry olarak, inside-bar başarısızlığını Hikkake olarak örnekler.

ideas.v8_translation: V8'in failed_breakout ve liquidity_sweep_reclaim hipotezleriyle doğrudan örtüşür: frozen barrier, excursion, reclaim/close trigger, stop beyond excursion, expiry and thesis invalidation.
ideas.implementation_surface: Existing expert modules and CandidateDraft episode identity; registry variant metadata.
ideas.guardrail: Pattern names are not contracts. Each variant needs exact closed-bar predicates, one origin Expert, one geometry, and dedup by setup anchor.
ideas.test_or_decision: The frozen v8_slice_001 definition is not retrofitted. New geometry/trigger is same family variant or a new registered family, with multiplicity counted.

ideas.title: Two-stage entry filter: event confirmation plus price bound
ideas.one_line_v8_action: event/close trigger'ını price-distance ve tradability mask ile birlikte kullan; signal ile admissible execution ayrımını koru.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap event/time trigger'larının entry fiyatını kontrol edemediğini; ikinci bir price filter'ın aşırı uzak entry'yi sınırlaması gerektiğini vurgular.

ideas.v8_translation: Bu V8 D-024 ve risk admission mantığıyla uyumludur: Candidate oluşabilir, fakat entry bar range, funding window, state quality, cost ve portfolio capacity veto edebilir; counterfactual outcome tutulur.
ideas.implementation_surface: lab.py + risk.py admission; reason_code TRADABILITY_MASK_VETO / capacity codes; canonical simulator.
ideas.guardrail: Veto candidate'ı silmez ve economic verdict üretmez. Mask threshold declared, pre-holdout and hash-bound kalır.
ideas.test_or_decision: O-019 firing-rate diagnostics; any threshold change requires new preregistration.

ideas.title: Fair-value, value area and initiative/responsive states
ideas.one_line_v8_action: Market Profile'i ancak sessionized volume-at-price veya TPO data contract'ı geldikten sonra state candidate yap.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap prior value area, POC, initial balance ve range extension üzerinden responsive mean-reversion ile initiative trend davranışını ayırır.

ideas.v8_translation: A future state could expose prior-session POC/value area, initial balance, value migration and acceptance/rejection. Current 1h OHLCV tape cannot reconstruct true TPO or volume-at-price without an explicit approximation contract.
ideas.implementation_surface: New materialized session view and dataset manifest; potentially a new Expert family.
ideas.guardrail: Do not call close/high/low a Market Profile proxy without naming the approximation and its fidelity level.
ideas.test_or_decision: Coverage/fidelity experiment first; O-007 decides whether the conclusion survives the richer data.

ideas.title: Confluence as independent evidence families, not indicator count
ideas.one_line_v8_action: confluence'i price, volume, funding/OI and external-context families olarak audit et; aynı fiyat serisinden gelen göstergeleri bağımsız oy sayma.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap yakın fiyat bariyerlerini cluster/confluence olarak birleştirir ve aynı fiyatı kullanan osilatörlerde multicollinearity riskine dikkat çeker.

ideas.v8_translation: Deterministic evidence score, candidate explanation ve family-level coverage diagnostics için kullanılabilir; fakat mevcut baseline'a gizli scorer olarak eklenemez.
ideas.implementation_surface: Candidate explanation fields first; later O-005 deterministic evidence-score challenger.
ideas.guardrail: Evidence family count, input lineage and search trials are recorded. More indicators do not equal more independent evidence.
ideas.test_or_decision: If used for admission or ranking, it needs O-005 style matched-coverage frozen-OOS comparison.

ideas.title: Aggressive/conservative entry and exit metadata
ideas.one_line_v8_action: entry timing, price distance and risk size'ı Candidate/Order metadata olarak ölç; bunları psikolojik etiket değil deterministic geometry olarak kullan.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap entry/exit davranışını zaman, fiyat ve risk boyutlarında göreli aggressive/conservative olarak ayırır; confirmation'ın garanti olmadığını da belirtir.

ideas.v8_translation: Candidate report'a distance_to_trigger, confirmation_delay, distance_to_barrier, stop_width_r ve risk_size_r gibi deterministic diagnostics eklenebilir.
ideas.implementation_surface: schema.py records, LabReport diagnostics; no new decision component.
ideas.guardrail: Labels must not imply trader psychology or economic quality. They are geometry/coverage descriptors and remain point-in-time.
ideas.test_or_decision: Add only as report fields with contract tests; promotion is not implied.

ideas.title: Position-management ladder: invalidate, expire, trail, scale
ideas.one_line_v8_action: static geometry baseline'ı koru; thesis invalidation, expiry, trailing, breakeven ve scale-out'u ayrı challenger variants olarak karşılaştır.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap pre-entry sizing ile post-entry exposure management'i ayırır; stop roll, scale-out, trailing, profit target ve expiry benzeri kararları trade management alanı sayar.

ideas.v8_translation: V8'de thesis invalidation ve expiry zaten distinct terminal labels olarak var. Breakeven/trail/partial exit ise active-position-management challenger olarak O-013 altında ele alınmalı.
ideas.implementation_surface: CanonicalSimulator event order, OpenPosition, ledger events, candidate outcome labels.
ideas.guardrail: Aynı-bar ambiguity, gap stops, funding settlement and costs remain canonical. Partial fills or learned execution are not silently introduced.
ideas.test_or_decision: Compare one moving part at a time against static geometry on an untouched chronological OOS; no dynamic management in the current preregistered slice.

ideas.title: Risk is deterministic: stop width, size and portfolio heat
ideas.one_line_v8_action: risk_unit ve exposure heat'i karar zincirinin deterministik sınırı olarak koru; Expert sayısı ile risk sayısını karıştırma.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap risk sizing -> stop sizing -> trade sizing sırasını kurar ve pozisyon riskini diğer risk biçimlerine dönüştürmenin overall risk'i yok etmediğini anlatır.

ideas.v8_translation: V8'in risk_unit, one active exposure per instrument/direction, max_heat and counterfactual rejection rules are the compatible baseline. Trade size is derived from declared risk and stop distance, not from signal confidence.
ideas.implementation_surface: risk.py, lifecycle.py ExposureBook, simulator.py R-unit ledger.
ideas.guardrail: Heat cap change is not a config tweak; O-018 requires preregistered costed comparison. No martingale or online equity mutation.
ideas.test_or_decision: Keep current caps until O-018 passes; audit exposure_share and executed-vs-rejected divergence.

ideas.title: Fixed versus dynamic sizing and drawdown controls
ideas.one_line_v8_action: dynamic sizing'i baseline'a alma; yalnızca O-016 kapsamında offline risk-policy challenger olarak incele.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap fixed ve current-equity sizing'in compounding asymmetry ürettiğini, daha büyük risk yüzdesinin recovery ve minimum win-rate yükünü artırabileceğini gösterir.

ideas.v8_translation: V8 için bu, signal edge'den bağımsız bir risk-policy experiment'tir: fixed 1R vs drawdown-conditioned or tiered sizing, each with risk/heat and drawdown diagnostics.
ideas.implementation_surface: Future manifest/risk policy version; not Expert or online learner.
ideas.guardrail: No martingale, no outcome-adaptive in-run mutation, no claiming that sizing creates edge. Book formulas are not universal thresholds.
ideas.test_or_decision: O-016 literature gap and preregistered frozen-OOS comparison; until then retain fixed deterministic baseline.

ideas.title: Worst-case order semantics and fail-closed execution
ideas.one_line_v8_action: stop fill, limit non-fill, gap slippage, ambiguity and censoring'i optimistic fillsiz canonical simulator'da açıkça tut.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap stop order'ın execution ama exact fill garantisi vermediğini, limit order'ın price guarantee but fill non-guarantee olduğunu ve worst-case planning'in zorunlu olduğunu açıklar.

ideas.v8_translation: Bu V8 Simulation Truth ile uyumludur: fill policy declared, gap semantics conservative, same-bar ambiguity STOP_FIRST, funding before orders, and right-censoring never fabricated.
ideas.guardrail: Level-1 simulator is attribution control, not execution certification. Missing depth/queue/latency authority keeps economic claim blocked.
ideas.test_or_decision: Keep golden and differential tests; richer order types only under O-007/O-008 and a new authority record.

ideas.title: Robustness is regime and parameter stability, not maximum backtest profit
ideas.one_line_v8_action: parameter search, regime coverage, equity path and drawdown diagnostics'i preregistration/multiplicity/frozen-OOS ile bağla.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap fazla kuralın curve fitting riskini artırdığını; IS/OOS ayrımı, farklı market conditions, parameter stability, drawdown ve equity curve'nin birlikte incelenmesi gerektiğini söyler.

ideas.v8_translation: V8 constitution bunu daha sıkı hale getirir: complete trial lineage, family-level multiplicity, chronological frozen OOS, block bootstrap and authority-first verdict.
ideas.guardrail: Kitaptaki 30 veya 300-500 trades genellemesi V8 significance threshold'u değildir; V8 minimum n=30 kendi preregistered coverage rule'udur.
ideas.test_or_decision: No new code required; use as review checklist and keep economic result NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM without authority receipt.

ideas.title: Candidate lifecycle as a multi-state position record
ideas.one_line_v8_action: setup, trigger, order, outcome, censoring and rejection statesini ayrı immutable records olarak koru.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap signal, price trigger, target, stop ve position management'i ayrı karar katmanları olarak anlatır; system components'i de ayrı başlıklar halinde kurar.

ideas.v8_translation: V8 Candidate lifecycle is the stronger formalization: all terminal states retained, counterfactual outcomes present, and execution separated from hypothesis.
ideas.implementation_surface: CandidateRegistry, CandidateTransition, Order, CounterfactualOutcome, materialized views.
ideas.guardrail: Executed trades alone are not the population; portfolio-state rejections are measured separately for D-027 attribution validity.
ideas.test_or_decision: Keep current lifecycle; survival/multi-state learning is future and registry-gated, not a reason to collapse records.

ideas.title: Selective participation and explicit coverage
ideas.one_line_v8_action: self-gating Experts abstain outside their habitat; coverage, rejection reasons and population divergence become first-class diagnostics.

book_source.paraphrase: Kitap filters'ın unwanted price action'ı azaltmak için kullanıldığını, ancak filtre çoğaldıkça aşırı filtreleme ve fırsat kaybı riskinin oluştuğunu belirtir.

ideas.v8_translation: This reinforces V8's all-cheap-self-gating baseline and D-027: report executed coverage and executed-vs-portfolio-rejected divergence instead of pretending abstention did not happen.
ideas.guardrail: Do not introduce a learned router or scorer merely to raise coverage. A filter must be deterministic, declared and compared at matched coverage when it becomes a component.
ideas.test_or_decision: Current baseline stays; future selection value belongs to O-005/O-012 and cannot be inferred from fewer trades.

recommended_next_experiments.question: Volatility compression -> closed-bar breakout Expert vs the simplest deterministic breakout baseline
recommended_next_experiments.gate: New preregistration, costed chronological frozen OOS, family correction, no holdout reuse

recommended_next_experiments.question: Volume-range-close quadrants as participation context for existing or new Experts
recommended_next_experiments.gate: PIT volume audit, descriptive table first, then one moving part and frozen OOS

recommended_next_experiments.question: Static geometry vs one active position-management challenger: thesis/expiry vs trail or scale-out
recommended_next_experiments.gate: Canonical simulator event order, same-bar ambiguity, costs and funding unchanged

recommended_next_experiments.question: Heat-cap and exposure-cap sweep for attribution validity
recommended_next_experiments.gate: Preregistered fixed Expert population, execution_share and KS diagnostics, no post-verdict retuning

recommended_next_experiments.question: Per-Expert history window versus global 32 bars
recommended_next_experiments.gate: Registry decision, state-hash migration, replay determinism and new frozen comparison

recommended_next_experiments.question: Market Profile state using a declared volume-at-price or TPO materialization
recommended_next_experiments.gate: Coverage/fidelity audit before any economic test; no OHLC proxy presented as true profile

recommended_next_experiments.question: Fixed risk versus drawdown-conditioned sizing as a risk-policy challenger
recommended_next_experiments.gate: No online mutation, no edge claim from sizing, full drawdown and heat diagnostics
